quests.title: Down Big Pit
quests.summary: Ride the cage ninety metres down Big Pit and follow the knocking in the dark.

steps.text: Pass the lamp-room check with Gwilym at Big Pit and take a lamp.
Ride the cage down and find Idris at the coal face.
Follow the knocking at the east face, and catch the Cobblet making it.
Ride back up and tell Gwilym.

quests.reward: A Davy Lamp, three Pwll Mawr cheddars and standing in Wales.

quests.title: Voices for the Eisteddfod
quests.summary: Bethania's choir is four voices short with the Eisteddfod a fortnight away. Find a tenor, a second tenor, a baritone and a bass.

steps.text: Find a first tenor in the Rhondda bakehouse.
Find a second tenor at the Dic Penderyn pub in Merthyr.
Find a baritone at the Workmen's Hall in Blaenavon.
Find a bass at Big Pit, once you have been down it.
Take the four voices back to Elwyn at Bethania Chapel.

quests.reward: An Eisteddfod Medal and standing in Wales.

quests.title: Trevithick's Wager
quests.summary: Replay the 1804 wager: Rhondda coal, a Steamlet to fire the boiler, and a doubting agent to beat.

steps.text: Ask Dai at the Rhondda Heritage Park for a bucket of steam coal.
Catch a Steamlet and show it to Bryn in Merthyr.
Beat the ironmaster's agent at Trevithick's plinth on the main street.

quests.reward: A Wager Guinea, two bars of Penydarren pig iron and standing in Wales.
